title: Performance of ChatGPT on a Radiology Board-style Examination: Insights into Current Strengths and Limitations

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Performance of ChatGPT on a Radiology Board-style Examination: Insights into Current Strengths and Limitations》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Purpose To assess the performance of ChatGPT on radiology board-style examination questions without images and to explore its strengths and limitations.

evidence.text: Purpose To assess the performance of ChatGPT on radiology board-style examination questions without images and to explore its strengths and limitations.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Performance of ChatGPT on a Radiology Board-style Examination: Insights into Current Strengths and Limitations》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Materials and Methods In this exploratory prospective study performed from February 25 to March 3, 2023, 150 multiple-choice questions designed to match the style, content, and difficulty of the Canadian Royal College and American Board of Radiology examinations were grouped by question type (lower-order [recall, understanding] and higher-order [apply, analyze, synthesize] thinking) and topic (physics, clinical).
